## Review record

Authorship: agent | human | mixed | trusted-bot

### Scope and risk

Describe the affected surface, important risks, and explicit non-goals.

### Verification evidence

List reproducible checks and results, or `Not run: <honest reason>`.
For each acceptance item, name the required environment, tested revision, actual
result, and accessible evidence. Distinguish local proof, hosted proof, and
explicit deferral. Link the existing task checklist when it owns the detailed
mapping; do not duplicate it. Name advisory failures and artifact access or
retention limits. A configured CI step is not an executed successful run.

### Review state

State unresolved findings and decisions, or `No unresolved review items.`
